fields.System.Title: INT-301 — Availability view
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an integration client, I want a fast endpoint for sellable quantity, so that the
webshop can ask about hundreds of products without straining the database.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the projection from
  • [INV-901](../INV/INV-901-maintain-availability-table.md), then an endpoint returns
  • availability for one or many products in a single read.
  • - Given the response, then it exposes last_updated_at per row.
  • - Given the endpoint, then its exclusion rules match
  • [INV-103](../INV/INV-103-query-available-quantity.md) exactly — a discrepancy between the two
  • is a defect.
  • - Given any caller, then the response states that this figure is indicative and must not
  • be used to commit stock.
  • - Given allocation, then it does not call this endpoint.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, inventory |
| Tables | product_availability |
| Risks | Projection used to promise stock ([doc 09 §12](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration · agreement with the live query |
